name: hcportal_getRegions
description: Returns the live (Removed = 0) regions of a given country from HC.Region, ordered by RegionName, for the cascading Country -> Region -> City selector in the run editor. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; any signed-in portal user.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: Filter: only regions whose CountryId matches are returned. NULL returns an empty rowset (no error).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (HC6.ValidatePortalAuth message) or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: RegionsResult
rowsets.description: List of regions for the given country, ordered alphabetically by RegionName. Only returned on successful authentication.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 49-52: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row.
